core.title: Nobe Single Robe Hook, Deltana BBN2009

text.description_html:
Deltana BBN2009, Modern Robe Hook

A hook such as this is as useful in the kitchen as it is in the bathroom. A stylish way to hang a robe, towels, or even a lady's purse, it's a beautiful, modern way to keep things off the floor in any room. This bathroom towel hook is made with the attention to quality that Deltana is known for. The Nobe Series Robe Hook features concealed screw mounting for a sleek, contemporary look. The modern styling means it will look good in even the most fashionable homes. It is available in satin nickel and polished chrome finishes.

Shop more of the Deltana Nobe Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Nobe Bathroom or Kitchen Towel Hook:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Projection: 2"
  • Hook Notch Length: 7/8"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, contemporary look.
  • Deltana BBN2009 Nobe Single Robe Hook Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 robe hook, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
